name: ultron-onshape-mcp
description: Ultron Onshape MCP — performance-tuned fork of jarvis-onshape-mcp. Let Claude drive real Onshape CAD: sketches, extrudes, fillets, mates, parametric iteration, FeatureScript custom features. 3.2x faster verification loop, ~46% fewer tokens per call, working circular patterns. Includes the vision-decomposition skill and side-by-side reference comparison tool.

ONSHAPE_API_KEY.title: Onshape API Key
ONSHAPE_API_KEY.description: Onshape API access key. Get one at https://dev-portal.onshape.com/ (the 'Access Key' value when you create an API key pair).

ONSHAPE_API_SECRET.title: Onshape API Secret
ONSHAPE_API_SECRET.description: Onshape API secret key (the 'Secret Key' shown once when you create the API key pair).
